control_flow: The start block repeats forever: it calls followInTheDark.
followInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, then if the line tracker is below 40 % curve left (0, 30), else if it is above 88 % curve right (30, 0); otherwise no motor block runs.
In bright light the outer if has no else, so nothing runs and the robot keeps its last movement (at the start it stands still).
avoidWalls, driveInTheDark, stopAtWall and followLine are defined but no path from the start reaches them.
